caveats.review_limit: This review checks linked static execution/grade receipts and source equations. It does not rerun the official scorer or rehash/read full prediction/cache arrays.

comparison.interpretation: That older student differs in target family/recipe/model lineage and precision. Same exposed F0 panel does not make it a matched comparison; the numeric gap is not attributable to the homogeneous T3 treatment. The clean T3 teacher-only trio grade is also not a matched student baseline.

grade.exposure: Repeatedly exposed F0 development evaluation subset; not a fresh holdout or cross-fold confirmation.

lineage_and_membership.actual_student_target: Trainer clips y and cached T separately to ±2, then uses (1-0.9)*clip(y)+0.9*clip(T). Nominal pre-clipping contribution per teacher is 0.9*0.8125/3 = 0.24375; clipping means this is not globally a linear blend.
lineage_and_membership.coefficient_field_caveat: The metadata/handoff source_coefficients / teacher_parents entries of 0.1 each and sum 0.3 describe source-family lineage rows. They are not the numeric weights used to build the homogeneous cached target; use the explicit 0.8125 target_contract and trainer alpha/clipping path.
lineage_and_membership.stored_teacher_target: T = float32(0.8125 * float32_mean(three epoch-2 teacher predictions)); equal arithmetic mean, no cache-construction clipping.
lineage_and_membership.student_recipe: 6-epoch OneCycle, fixed epoch 5; seed 3; GRU 2x256, AdamW fp16 fit; FP32 inference; F0; no fit-time evaluation.
lineage_and_membership.teacher_prediction_validation: Cache input receipts bind source-qualified train/fit-valid predictions and teacher CP/provenance hashes; full array SHA/finite validation and frozen consumer validation passed. Exact ordered fit/evaluation membership excluded the 468 evaluated valid-source groups.
